selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Conservative small-beta SpookyNet neutral charge pair head; directly satisfies the required low-risk charge-neutral/electrostatic pair-energy mechanism while preserving force conservativity and avoiding ordinary atomwise residual simplification.
Switched Coulomb/damped SpookyNet charge kernel exploit; tests the evidence-backed electrostatic formula variant with explicit mechanism id, repo trace, and current insertion point.
Element-biased neutral charge-pair correction; keeps the electrostatic q_i q_j mechanism but probes whether element-conditioned charge offsets improve ISO17 energy/gap calibration.
Aggressive charge/electronic interaction variant; tests whether learned charge scalars should gate pair messages as well as contribute pair energy.
Charge-pair energy plus energy-balanced warmup; explores interaction between the SpookyNet electrostatic mechanism and short-budget energy/gap supervision.
Radial shell charge-pair decomposition; higher-capacity electrostatic variant that separates short- and medium-range pair-energy structure without changing benchmark semantics.
Exact source replicate variance control for generation_021/proposal_001; preserves attribution discipline before interpreting small Q_total or split-metric deltas.
Electrostatic-vs-residual ablation/control; explicitly distinguishes q_i q_j pair-energy structure from ordinary atomwise residual calibration.

selection_policy: Prioritize the fresh SpookyNet evidence package and the user's explicit charge-neutral/electrostatic pair-energy requirements. Select the conservative small-beta charge head, switched/element-biased electrostatic exploits, aggressive charge/electronic and multishell jumps, an objective-interaction jump, the exact source replicate, and the electrostatic-vs-residual ablation. Defer the tiny readout wildcard and the non-electrostatic body-order comparator because the selected ablation plus exact replicate already isolate electrostatic structure while preserving enough exploit/jump coverage.
